fact: The handbook says the Eswatini DroughtMap Hub, run with the National Drought Management Center, Ministry of Agriculture and Meteorological Service, computes a Combined Drought Indicator from CHIRPS and MODIS satellite data and publishes it per inkhundla in a public area.
The handbook says the Combined Drought Indicator is computed automatically each month for the previous month, then reviewed, validated and published.

An RCMRD report for Eswatini's National Disaster Management Agency (CTCN-funded) says crop monitoring pilots combining drones and Sentinel-2 imagery were run at four sites in April 2021, and a satellite-based maize yield model was applied nationally for 2020.
